evidence.title: DeepSAGE: Stage-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Structured CBT Counseling Dialogue

summary: Researchers unveil DeepSAGE, a novel AI framework using stage-aware reinforcement learning to enhance structured cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) dialogue systems. The approach aims to improve therapeutic interactions by adapting to different stages of counseling.
title: DeepSAGE Introduces Stage-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Structured CBT Counseling Dialogue
